name: submit_review
description: Hand in today's review: what you noticed (insights) and what is coming due (nudges). Call it once.

insights.description: Zero to six findings, most important first.

title.description: The finding in a few plain words, to the owner.

detail.description: One or two sentences of specifics.

status.description: Goals only: two or three words, such as "On pace".

status_needs_you.description: Goals only: true when it needs the owner.

lead.description: True for the one finding that matters most.

basis.description: What it rests on, two to four words: "14 tasks".

evidence.description: One to four items, each pointing at something in the context.

text.description: Exactly what in the context shows it.

topic.description: The sensitive topic it touches, by name, if any.

remember.description: The finding as a short third-person note for memory.

offer.description: Optional next step, as the owner would ask for it.

label.description: Two to five words: "Plan around late meetings".

request.description: The full request, ready to send.

nudges.description: Zero to three heads-ups for things coming due.

title.description: A few words: "Passport form due Friday".

body.description: One line on what to do.

at.description: Local date and time to notify, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.
